{{Quote|It's a job, kid. That's the long and short of it.|The guard to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
A '''security guard''', recently hired by [[Cosinga Palpatine]] as of [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], was tasked with retrieving [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from the ''[[Jafan III]]'' at [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] [[Hanna City Spaceport|Starport]]. He was murdered by Palpatine along with everyone else onboard soon after the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]; his body was disposed of by agents of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] along with the others. He was known to be stern and wry in character.<ref name="Darth P" />
